normalised: run ids of the form YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-NN, and the run id the service issued -> <run-id>
dates with a time of day (ISO or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', with or without ' UTC') -> <time>
times of day 'HH:MM:SS' with or without fractions and ' UTC' -> <time>
elapsed durations drawn as 'N s' or 'N min N s' (a whole drawn value) -> <duration>

static.data: web/dist copied to a temporary folder, data.js written by web/scripts/fixture-data.mjs from web/fixtures/*.json (the stage 0 'fixture' variant)
